items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 32:1
items.html: The first reason is, further, because of her root in the ten Sefirot of direct light. For from the beginning of her emanation, she came out in the aspect of back to back with Hochma, in the secret of “for He desires mercy,” as is known; and afterward, in order to emanate ZON, she returned face to face with Hochma, as is known. Therefore Bina divided into two parts, which are almost opposites of one another: in her first part she chooses Hassadim and rejects Hochma, and in her second part she draws Hochma. And it is known that every disparity of form divides the spiritual into two. Therefore the whole level of Bina likewise divides into two, where her GAR is in the aspect of covered Hassadim, and her ZAT is in revealed Hassadim; and because of this they become two separate Partzufim.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 32:2
items.html: The second reason is that the imprint of the bottom Hey in the screen of the Rosh of AA removes only the ZAT of Bina from the law of Rosh, namely YESHSUT, but does not remove the GAR of Bina from the law of Rosh, namely AVI, because they are covered Hassadim, and upon Hassadim there was never any restriction, as is known. And therefore they were separated into two: AVI are the aspect of Rosh and GAR, and YESHSUT are already the aspect of Guf.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 32:3
items.html: The third reason is because of the Yesod of Atik. For since AA and Atik are two Partzufim, AA became the aspect of AB of Atzilut, and it receives Hochma from the HGT of Atik, while from the NHY of Atik it receives Hassadim for Bina and ZON that came out from the Rosh, as is known. Therefore AVI, who clothe upon the HGT of AA, receive covered Hassadim, since the NHY of Atik bestows upon Bina and the HGT of AA. But YESHSUT can already receive revealed Hassadim, since they are below the Yesod of Atik. Because of this they divided into two: AVI are the Partzuf of covered Hassadim, and YESHSUT are the Partzuf of revealed Hassadim.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 32:4
items.html: The fourth reason is that AVI, being above the chest of AA, are still considered the aspect of the three Partzufim above the Parsa, and are considered the aspect of the name MB of the plain, the filling, and the filling of the filling. This is unlike YESHSUT, who are below the Parsa of AA, from the aspect of the chest, where the middle line of the upper half-Partzuf ends; therefore, from the side of the lights, YESHSUT have already gone out from the aspect of this name MB, as above. And therefore they were separated into two: AVI are the aspect of MB also from the side of the lights, but YESHSUT are the aspect of MB only from the side of the vessels alone, since they are still found above the ending of the legs of the upper half-Partzuf, which extends down to the Tabur, as is known. So the difference between them is great.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 32:5
items.html: The fifth reason is because of the imprint of the bottom Hey of Katnut remaining at the chest of AVI, which imprint makes a Parsa within AVI themselves, from where downward the 120 combinations of Elohim begin. And since YESHSUT begin from the chest and below of AVI, therefore all of their ZAT are the aspect of the names of Elohim, as is known — unlike upper Ima, who is the names of Ehyeh, and entirely mercy, as is known. (869, Items 11, 12, and 13) And there are further reasons for this, as written elsewhere in their place.
